subject: SRE replacement + proposed level change for infra-core
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Replace SRE position vacated May 12 — propose re-level

Team,

Following Arjun's departure (effective 2026-05-12) the infra-core SRE slot (pos id 9182) is open. I recommend we refill the headcount but re-level the hire to SRE-II (from SRE-I) to match the rising operational scope (multi-region failover, persistent KV scaling work).

Why re-level:
- Current backlog requires someone with solid on-call ownership and incident runbook ownership (SRE-II expectations).
- We have two ongoing projects (KV scaling, cross-region replication) that need deeper systems experience.

Proposed ask:
- Approve headcount refill for pos 9182 (replace, not net-new).
- Approve level change: SRE-I -> SRE-II for this slot.
- Compensation guidance: suggest targeting 12% uplift over previous target comp (details in attached brief).

I linked a short brief and the draft comp-band proposal (attached). If you agree, I'll route to Recruiting and HR to prepare an internal transfer first (we have Rohan Mehta on the bench who expressed interest) and prepare an external recruit fallback.

Attachments: sre-replacement-brief.pdf

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Replace SRE position vacated May 12 — propose re-level

Markus —

Thanks for the write-up. Approve in principle to refill and to consider re-leveling to SRE-II pending a short cost delta and success metrics for the role. Please provide:
- Expected comp band (base + target on-target total comp).
- Headcount delta (this is replace, confirm no net-new FTE).
- Quick note on runway if we delay hire 8-12 weeks.

I've attached a quick comp-band worksheet to help standardize the numbers. Once we have the finalized numbers I'll route to Finance for sign-off.

Attachment: comp-band-proposal.xlsx

Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-05-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Replace SRE position vacated May 12 — propose re-level

Markus/Laura —

I endorse the re-level to SRE-II for technical reasons (ownership of cross-region KV work and deeper on-call incident resolution). Quick numbers below based on our current ML/infra bands:
- Previous target comp (SRE-I): base $160k -> OTE $190k
- Proposed SRE-II target: base $178k-$196k (target midpoint $187k), OTE $220k approx depending on equity mix
- Suggested initial offer: midpoint + 6% (to be competitive for internal transfers)

We do have an internal candidate: Rohan Mehta (currently infra-support). He's expressed interest and has the necessary on-call experience; I'd like to run a short technical loop (2 interviews) and validate. If Rohan accepts, it's a pure transfer (no new headcount). If not, we open to external search and align comp to the SRE-II band above.

Recruiting note: please mark this as high-priority internal transfer first. I attached the org headcount export for the platform team showing the slot is available in our pool.

Attachment: org-headcount-summary.csv

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of ML Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

All —

Catching up on this thread. From a Finance/ops perspective we need two things before final OK:
1) Confirm that this is a replace (net headcount delta = 0).
2) Finalized comp band and expected first-year on-target spend (include equity estimate).

If it's a pure internal transfer (Rohan), Finance is typically OK and we can fast-track. If external, please provide the comp package so we can confirm budget vs. team plan.

Also: add a Workday req and provide the req id so we can track approvals. If Recruiting needs a vendor for external search, CC "talent@talento.ai".

Jonas

- Candidate path: internal-first (Rohan Mehta) — please schedule technical loop with Neha and confirm by EOD next week. If Rohan declines, open external search at SRE-II band below.
- Compensation: target offer at midpoint + 6% (approx base $198k target — final number to be set by Recruiting with Finance).

Jonas — please consider this greenlit for Finance sign-off; Laura/HR please prepare a transfer/offer packet. I'm attaching a screenshot of my sign-off for the record.
